items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: The band leader, we played at the Dew Drop, uh, and, uh, Otis Ducker had the band there.

ctx.x: The only problem was that we got stranded in, and, uh, Port Arthur, Texas. Stranded. I forgot who all was on the band. Um, it might have been, uh, uh, Lil' Dime, DuPont. August DuPont, yeah. Yeah, he, I think he might have been on it and some other guys. I don't, I can't remember, but we got stranded. And how we got home was that, uh, Earl Barnes got in touch with him and he was a Mason and he had the Masons to pay for the bus to get us back to New Orleans. He gets back home, yeah. You know. And, uh, that was one…
And, uh, uh, uh, so, yes, uh, did, uh, were you ever, did, did, did, did the Dew Drop, shows like the Dew Drop pay very well?
